opening_title: Unittest class instances no longer released on test teardown since pytest 8.2.0

expected_outcome.rationale: The explicit pytest 8.2 commit-linked regression retains unittest instances after teardown, unlike failure to construct a Tornado runTest instance during collection. The opening explains the internal change and links a test it says did not catch the regression, but supplies no isolated runnable lifetime example, package list or OS release. Group the explicitly linked follow-up 12266 and related lifetime issue 12198 conservatively for training exclusion; their edited text is annotation only and neither becomes replay evidence.
